paper.title_en: Bouncing shellworld embedded in charged AdS spacetime
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the cosmological evolution of a spherical brane within the shellworld (dark bubble) scenario embedded in a five-dimensional charged AdS bulk spacetime. For zero or small value of the brane cosmological constant, the shellworld universe has a nonsingular bouncing and cyclic nature with the bounce induced by the charge parameter of the bulk spacetime. On large value of the brane cosmological constant, the shellworld undergoes a nonsingular bounce and expands eternally. Under certain conditions, the brane bounces outside the bulk horizons, leading to a geometrical resolution of the Cauchy horizon instability present in standard braneworld models. Furthermore, analysis of linear scalar perturbations reveals that test scalar field modes remain regular and non-divergent across the bounce. Finally, we incorporate uniformly distributed long strings in the bulk and demonstrate that the bounce still persists while avoiding the horizon instability.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文探讨了壳世界情景中的膜宇宙学，涉及弹跳行为及柯西视界不稳定性的解决，属于广义相对论基础范畴，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 嵌入带电AdS时空的弹跳壳世界
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了嵌入五维带电AdS体时空中的壳世界（暗气泡）情景中球形膜宇宙学的演化。对于膜宇宙学常数为零或较小的情况，壳世界宇宙具有非奇异的弹跳和循环性质，弹跳由体时空的电荷参数诱发。对于膜宇宙学常数较大的情况，壳世界发生非奇异弹跳并永恒膨胀。在某些条件下，膜在体视界之外弹跳，从而导致标准膜世界模型中存在的柯西视界不稳定性的几何解决。此外，对线性标量扰动的分析表明，测试标量场模式在弹跳过程中保持正则且不发散。最后，我们纳入体中的均匀分布长弦，并证明弹跳仍然持续，同时避免了视界不稳定性。
